faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR Madras Complex Security Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Security Assistant post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is for Ex-servicemen, JCO in Army or equivalent in other Paramilitary Forces with five years of experience in security work.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Security Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Security Assistant post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Security Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 35400 - 62400 Per Month, corresponding to Level-6.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CSIR Madras Complex Security Assistant jobs?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of CSIR Madras Complex from 17 August 2026 to 16 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill/Physical and Personality Assessment Test, followed by a Written Examination, and finally, a Merit List will be prepared.

faq.question: Q8. Where is CSIR Madras Complex located?
faq.answer: CSIR Madras Complex is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600113.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any relaxation in the age limit?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per Government of India orders for categories like Ex-servicemen, widows, and divorced women.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Security Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Security Assistant in CSIR Madras Complex Recruitment 2026.
